notes.title: Demo Release in 1 Week! (February 5th)
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/28825135/ced9186fbaeb242d02b3cf7b56b842fb9bf04366.gif

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

Just to let you all know that the demo for Run Bird Run! will be released in one week on February 5th. ːPfishː

The demo will also feature 10 achievements for running between 100 and 1000 meters, and your score and highscore will carry over to the official release of the game on March 10th!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312100/Run_Bird_Run/


You can also follow my Steam Developer Page to get automatically notified of any of my releases! ːPcatː
